From January 2027, check on your payslip whether your net pay went down; so far there is no act extending the exemption.

concediu_medical_procente.pentru: For employees who take sick leave for ordinary illness
concediu_medical_procente.ce: short sick leave is paid at 55% (up to 7 days) or 65% (8–14 days), not 75%

pierzi.ipoteza: 5 days of sick leave on a base of 200 lei a day: 550 lei at 55%, compared with 750 lei at 75%

pasi: Check the percentage applied on your payslip: it is set by the total days in the same illness episode, not by each certificate.
If the episode went past 14 days, the percentage must be 75%.

concediu_medical_prima_zi.pentru: For employees who take sick leave
concediu_medical_prima_zi.ce: one day of each illness episode is not paid, between 1 February 2026 and 31 December 2027

pierzi.ipoteza: one day on a base of 200 lei at 55%

pasi: Check on your payslip that the unpaid day was deducted only once per episode, not for every follow-up certificate.
Maternity, maternity risk, patients in national health programmes and hospitalisation are exempt: if you are in one of these situations, the day must not be deducted.

cass_intretinere.pentru: For people supporting a husband, wife or parent with no income
cass_intretinere.ce: they are no longer health-insured for free; you can insure them for 2,430 lei a year each

pierzi.ipoteza: one dependent person: 6 minimum wages × 4,050 lei × 10%

pasi: Decide whether you want to insure them: the option is final for that year.
File the Single Tax Return, chapter II, the section for dependent persons.
Pay 25% when you file and the remaining 75% by 25 May of the following year.

solutie.ce: The Single Tax Return is filed and paid online, for free.

cass_somaj.ce: 10% health contribution withheld from the benefit; the benefit does not go up in 2026

pierzi.ipoteza: benefit of 1,000 lei a month, 10% withheld

pasi: You do not need to do anything: the contribution is withheld automatically and keeps you insured.

cass_crestere_copil.ce: 10% health contribution withheld from the allowance, from August 2025

pierzi.ipoteza: allowance of 2,000 lei a month, 10% withheld

pasi: You do not need to do anything: the deduction is automatic.
Check on the payment decision that the net allowance is right.

pensie_vpr_2026.pentru: For pensioners in the public system
pensie_vpr_2026.ce: pensions are not indexed in 2026: the reference point stays at 81 lei
pasi: You do not need to do anything: in 2026 the pension is not recalculated by indexation.
Yearly indexation returns from 2027.

pfa_norma_minima_2026.pentru: For sole traders (PFA) taxed on an income norm
pfa_norma_minima_2026.ce: the income norm can no longer be below 12 minimum wages, that is 48,600 lei for 2026
pasi: Compare the 48,600 lei norm with your real income in 2026.
Discuss with your accountant whether it is worth moving to the real system.
File and pay through the Single Tax Return by 25 May 2027.

solutie.ce: The Single Tax Return is filed and paid online, for free.

pfa_cass_plafon_72.pentru: For sole traders and liberal professions with net income above 243,000 lei a year
pfa_cass_plafon_72.ce: the CASS cap rises from 60 to 72 minimum wages

pierzi.ipoteza: net income above 291,600 lei: maximum CASS 29,160 lei, compared with 24,300 lei

pasi: Set aside the CASS difference for the 2026 Single Tax Return.
Pay by 25 May 2027.

solutie.ce: The Single Tax Return is filed and paid online, for free.

inchiriere_termen_scurt_2026.pentru: For owners who let 1–7 rooms short-term (Airbnb, Booking)
inchiriere_termen_scurt_2026.ce: a 10% final tax on 70% of receipts, that is 7%, with no bookkeeping

pierzi.ipoteza: 30,000 lei received in a year: 10% of 21,000 lei

pasi: Fill in the occupancy sheet and the income part of the tax record register.
Declare your 2026 income in the Single Tax Return and pay by 25 May 2027.
Above 7 rooms, the income becomes an independent activity, with CAS and CASS.

solutie.ce: The Single Tax Return is filed and paid online, for free.

salariu_minim_2026.pentru: For employees on the minimum wage
salariu_minim_2026.ce: the gross minimum wage rises to 4,325 lei from 1 July 2026
pasi: Check your July 2026 payslip: the full-time base salary must be at least 4,325 lei gross.
If it is not, ask your employer to correct it.

ajutor_incalzire.pentru: For families with a net income of at most 1,386 lei per member (2,053 lei for a single person)
ajutor_incalzire.ce: a monthly heating allowance between November and March, only on application
pasi: Calculate the average net income per family member.
Ask for the form at the town hall of the place where your home is.
The general deadline is 15 October; ask the town hall whether you can still apply and from when it is paid.

insolventa_persoane_fizice.pentru: For people with debts they can no longer pay
insolventa_persoane_fizice.ce: personal insolvency can be requested from debts of 15 minimum wages, that is 64,875 lei
pasi: Put together the list of overdue debts and creditors.
Ask the insolvency commission in your county for information.
If you are past retirement age and have debts of at most 43,250 lei, ask about the simplified procedure.

sere_solare_2026.pentru: For people who own greenhouses, polytunnels, seedbeds, mushroom farms or grain silos
sere_solare_2026.ce: no building tax on them in 2026; from 2027, half
pasi: Check on the town hall tax assessment that these buildings are listed as exempt for 2026.
If not, ask the local tax office to correct it.

masa_sanatoasa_2026.pentru: For parents with children at a state kindergarten or school
masa_sanatoasa_2026.ce: the “Healthy Meal” programme continues in 2026 in the schools included
pasi: Ask the kindergarten or school whether it is in the programme in 2026.

saracie_energetica_2026.pentru: For families with a net income of at most 1,784 lei per member (1,940 lei for a single person)
saracie_energetica_2026.ce: 50 lei a month off the electricity bill, until 31 December 2026

salvezi.ipoteza: 50 lei a month for November and December 2026, if you sign up in November

pasi: Calculate the net income per family member.
Sign up through the EPIDS app or at the town hall.
The support is paid from the month you sign up, so the sooner you sign up, the more you get.

salarii_stat_inghetate_2026.ce: base salary and bonuses stay in 2026 at the December 2025 level
pasi: Overtime is compensated only with time off: ask for it within 90 days at most.

vouchere_vacanta_stat_2026.pentru: For public-sector employees with a net base salary of at most 6,000 lei
pasi: Check with HR whether you have received the vouchers for 2026.

handicap_indemnizatie_solidaritate.pentru: For pensioners with a severe visual, severe or pronounced disability
handicap_indemnizatie_solidaritate.ce: the solidarity allowance is not paid before 1 January 2027
pasi: You do not need to do anything now.
Ask the social assistance office which documents you will need from 2027.

rovinieta_2026.ce: the yearly road vignette costs between 228 and 330 lei, depending on the Euro standard
pasi: Check the Euro standard in your registration certificate.
Buy the vignette for the period you need: for occasional trips, the 10- or 30-day one can be cheaper than the yearly one.

solutie.ce: You buy the vignette online from CNAIR.

efactura_5_zile_lucratoare.pentru: For sole traders and companies that issue invoices
efactura_5_zile_lucratoare.ce: invoices go to RO e-Factura within 5 working days of being issued
pasi: Set the 5-working-day deadline in your invoicing software.
Send invoices to individuals (B2C) within the same deadline.

solutie.ce: Invoices are sent through SPV or through invoicing software connected to RO e-Factura.

burse_studenti_2026_2027.ce: the minimum social grant is 925 lei in the 2026–2027 academic year
pasi: Ask the faculty office when the social grant applications are due.
Prepare the income documents your university asks for and file on time.

plafonul_scutire_tva_2025.pentru: For those who have: sole trader (PFA), sole trader on income norm, SRL micro-company, SRL dividends
plafonul_scutire_tva_2025.ce: The VAT exemption threshold for small businesses rose to 395,000 lei from 1 September 2025
pasi: Track the turnover of the calendar year, calculated under art. 310 para. (2). The threshold is 395,000 lei; when you exceed it, you must apply for VAT registration by the date you exceed it at the latest.

te_poti_scoate_2025.pentru: For those who have: sole trader (PFA), sole trader on income norm, SRL micro-company, SRL dividends
te_poti_scoate_2025.ce: You can ask to be removed from the VAT register if you registered by 1 September 2025 only because you passed 300,000 lei
pasi: If you qualify, file with ANAF the request for removal from the register of persons registered for VAT purposes, between the 1st and the 10th of the month following your tax period. Until the decision you remain a VAT payer, then you file the last VAT return by the 25th of the month following the decision.

daca_treci_lei_2025.pentru: For those who have: sole trader (PFA), sole trader on income norm, SRL micro-company, SRL dividends
daca_treci_lei_2025.ce: If you pass 395,000 lei, you apply for VAT registration by the day you pass it at the latest; being late means back-dated VAT
pasi: If you exceed the threshold, apply for VAT registration by the date you exceed it at the latest. If you were late, you ask for the registration date to be changed to the date of exceeding and include the amounts in the first VAT return filed after registration.

srl_ul_pierde_2026.pentru: For those who have: SRL micro-company
srl_ul_pierde_2026.ce: The SRL loses the micro regime if revenue passes 100,000 euro, and pays profit tax from the quarter in which it passes
pasi: Track the company's revenue during the year (turnover, together with that of linked companies) against 100,000 euro; if you exceed it, profit tax is owed from the quarter of exceeding. If you notified ANAF that you apply or leave the micro regime between 1 January 2026 and the entry into force of the ordinance, file a new declaration of mentions (art. 10 para. (4)).

srl_ul_nou_2026.pentru: For those who have: SRL micro-company
srl_ul_nou_2026.ce: A new SRL has 90 days from registration to hire its first employee and stay in the micro regime
pasi: If you have a new SRL that applies the micro regime, hire the first employee within 90 days of the date of registration in the trade register at the most.

daca_singurul_salariat_2026.pentru: For those who have: SRL micro-company
daca_singurul_salariat_2026.ce: If your only employee leaves, you have 30 days to hire another to stay micro
pasi: If your only employee leaves, hire a replacement within 30 days at the most (permanent contract or one of at least 12 months).

bonificatie_impozitul_veniturile_2026.pentru: For those who have: SRL micro-company
bonificatie_impozitul_veniturile_2026.ce: A 3% rebate on the 2025 micro-enterprise income tax, granted by ANAF ex officio
pasi: Check in the company's Virtual Private Space the decision by which ANAF established the 3% rebate and that the amount has entered the tax record; it is offset against other obligations, not refunded.

pfa_contributiile_pilon_2026.pentru: For those who have: sole trader (PFA), Pillar III
pfa_contributiile_pilon_2026.ce: Sole trader: contributions to Pillar III, occupational pensions and PEPP fall within a limit of 400 euro a year
pasi: Keep proof of payment of contributions to the voluntary pension fund, the occupational fund or PEPP and ask for the fund statement; take them into account when filling in the single return for 2026 income, up to 400 euro a year for each type.

pfa_sumele_platite_2026.pentru: For those who have: sole trader (PFA)
pfa_sumele_platite_2026.ce: Sole trader: amounts paid for ETFs through authorised intermediaries fall within a limit of 400 euro a year
pasi: Keep the supporting documents from the intermediary for ETF transactions settled from 1 March 2026 (your data, the settlement date, the instruments and the value) and take them into account in the single return for 2026, up to 400 euro a year.

salariat_contributiile_pilon_2026.pentru: For those who have: salary, Pillar III
salariat_contributiile_pilon_2026.ce: Employee: contributions to Pillar III, occupational pensions and PEPP are deducted up to 400 euro a year, from March 2026 pay
pasi: If you pay contributions to Pillar III, an occupational pension or PEPP, check on your payslip each month that your employer has taken the deduction into account, up to 400 euro a year.

salariat_sumele_platite_2026.ce: Employee: amounts paid for ETFs through authorised intermediaries are deducted up to 400 euro a year
pasi: Keep the supporting documents from the intermediary for ETF transactions settled from 1 March 2026, with the data required by law, for the deduction from salary; when you change employer, take the document showing the deductions granted.

bursa_merit_scoala_2026.pentru: For those who have: pupil or student
bursa_merit_scoala_2026.ce: School merit scholarship: 450 lei a month from the 2026-2027 school year
pasi: If you receive the merit scholarship, check at school that the amount paid for the 2026-2027 school year is 450 lei a month.

bursa_sociala_scoala_2026.pentru: For those who have: pupil or student
bursa_sociala_scoala_2026.ce: School social scholarship: 300 lei a month from the 2026-2027 school year
pasi: If you receive the social scholarship, check at school that the amount paid for the 2026-2027 school year is 300 lei a month.

bursa_tehnologica_scoala_2026.pentru: For those who have: pupil or student
bursa_tehnologica_scoala_2026.ce: School technological scholarship: 300 lei a month from the 2026-2027 school year
pasi: If you receive the technological scholarship, check at school that the amount paid for the 2026-2027 school year is 300 lei a month.

prima_activare_somerii_2002.ce: Activation bonus for unemployed people without benefit: 1,000 lei, tax-free, in two instalments
pasi: Be registered as unemployed with the employment agency for at least 30 days before you take a full-time job, and ask for the activation bonus.
Check that you received the first instalment (50% of the amount set) when you started the job and the second instalment (50%) after the 3 months from starting have passed.

prima_incadrare_somerii_2002.ce: Commuting bonus for unemployed people who work more than 15 km from home: 0.5 lei/km, at most 55 lei/day, 12 months
pasi: If you take a job more than 15 km from your domicile or residence, ask for the commuting bonus at the employment agency where you are registered.

prima_instalare_somerii_2002.ce: Settlement bonus for unemployed people who move more than 50 km: 12,500 lei, 15,500 lei with family, 3,500 lei for the second spouse
pasi: Before you move for a job more than 50 km away, ask the employment agency where you are registered how to apply for the settlement bonus and which documents you must submit.

prima_relocare_cheltuielile_2002.ce: Relocation bonus: 75% of housing costs, up to 900 lei a month, for at most 36 months
pasi: If you move for a job more than 50 km away, ask for the relocation bonus at the employment agency where you are registered and prepare proof of the rent and utilities at the new home.

motorina_agricultura_rambursare_2026.ce: Diesel in agriculture: reimbursement from 1.996 to 2.557 lei/litre, depending on how much the excise duty falls in the crisis
pasi: Check in the statement or in the reimbursement decision that the amount per litre matches the level of the excise duty reduction in the period when you bought the diesel: 2.557 lei/l at 5%, 2.417 at 10%, 2.277 at 15%, 2.137 at 20%, 1.996 at 25%.

grant_pana_lei_2026.ce: Grant of up to 333 lei/ha for maize and sunflower affected by the 2025 drought
pasi: If you grew maize and/or sunflower in 2025, filed a payment request with APIA and have a damage assessment report with at least 30% damage, file the support request (model in annex no. 3) at the APIA centre where you filed the 2025 payment request. The legal deadline is at most 20 working days after the agriculture directorates send the lists to APIA. Ask APIA for the pre-printed request, with the areas already filled in. You can also send it by post, fax or e-mail.
Check with your county's agriculture directorate that the damage assessment report appears in the summary statement sent to APIA. Without this registration you are not eligible.

If you have a different bank account from the one in the 2025 payment request, fill in the “new IBAN code” field and attach a copy of the bank details document. If nothing has changed, you do not need to attach other identification documents.

If you have a drought insurance policy or benefit from DR-31 and have already received compensation, enter the amount in the request, in the Declarations and commitments section. If you receive it after filing, tell APIA within 15 days. If compensation plus grant exceed 80% of eligible expenses, you repay the difference with interest.

If you took over by transfer the holding of a producer who filed the 2025 payment request, attach to the request a copy of the document proving the takeover and a copy of the report drawn up in the name of the original producer.

Check your account to see whether you received the grant by 31 December 2026. The correct amount is 333 lei/ha multiplied by the degree of damage in the report and divided by 100 (or the full 333 lei/ha, above 90% damage), on the area in the report, but not more than the one in the 2025 payment request. It may be lower if the budget is not enough. If you receive a rejection notice, you can challenge it under Law 554/2004. Before going to court, ask for the act to be revoked within 30 days of notification.
Keep for 10 years, from the date you receive the amount, all documents showing the support was granted.

tichetul_masa_poate_2026.ce: A meal voucher can be worth at most 45 lei, from October 2026 until March 2027
pasi: If you receive meal vouchers, check on your payslip or meal card that the value of one voucher does not exceed 45 lei for the months to which the order applies (from October 2026, plus February and March 2027). If it does, ask your employer for an explanation.

tarife_noi_kilometru_2026.ce: New per-kilometre rates (TollRo) for goods vehicles over 3.5 tonnes on motorways and national roads
pasi: Check the per-kilometre rate that applies to you: look in the annex for the vehicle category by maximum authorised mass and the EURO class from the registration certificate, then the road type (motorway or national road). Compare it with what you are charged for a trip.

camioanele_electrice_platesc_2026.ce: Electric trucks pay 75% less than the EURO VI rate
pasi: If you have an electric goods vehicle over 3.5 tonnes, check in the registration certificate (field P.3) that the electric energy source appears. Then the rate in the “Electric vehicles” column applies to you.

ajutorul_crescatorii_porci_2026.ce: The aid for pig farmers in Law 175/2026 is extended to companies too, with a request within 10 working days
pasi: If your company raises pigs, read the conditions in art. 4 of Law 175/2026 and file the request for state aid within 10 working days of the law entering into force.
